meta.title: ResQCare AI: find emergency hospital care
meta.description: Find nearby hospitals that can treat your emergency, with honest data on what is confirmed. Call 112 in a life-threatening emergency.

footer.disclaimer: ResQCare AI helps you find hospitals and request ambulances. It does not give medical advice, and hospital information can change. In a life-threatening emergency, call 112 now.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.updated: Demo build. Review with a lawyer before real use.
privacy.p1: We collect only what is needed: your location for a search (not stored with the search), and for ambulance requests your contact name and phone number.
privacy.p2: Location shared with a hospital is rounded to about 1 km and deleted after 30 days. Ambulance location points are deleted 24 hours after the trip.
privacy.p3: Phone numbers are hidden from anyone who does not need them, and never appear in links, logs or analytics.
privacy.p4: Analytics record only anonymous events. We never record your symptoms text, coordinates or phone number for analytics.
privacy.p5: You can ask to delete your account from your profile. Your details are anonymised within 30 days.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.updated: Demo build. Review with a lawyer before real use.
terms.p1: ResQCare AI is an information and coordination tool. It does not replace emergency services.
terms.p2: In a life-threatening emergency, call 112 or 108 first.
terms.p3: Hospital information may be incomplete or out of date. Confidence labels show how sure we are. Always call to confirm.
terms.p4: Do not misuse ambulance requests. Fake requests may be reported to the authorities.
terms.p5: In demo mode no real ambulance is dispatched and all hospitals are fictional.

disclaimer.title: Medical disclaimer
disclaimer.updated: Please read before relying on this service.
disclaimer.p1: ResQCare AI does not give medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.
disclaimer.p2: Matching uses the facilities hospitals have on record. It cannot judge a patient's condition.
disclaimer.p3: Ratings and reviews are opinions. They do not show what a hospital can treat.
disclaimer.p4: Travel times and distances are estimates.
